lines: Elike was a good man by general knowledge.
And now, after all this time, in a neutral setting, I would still agree.
I could once vouche my life on his good character.
But when the venom of Elike’s poorly conducted habits struck me in the neck, it stripped me of every special feeling I had associated with our relationship.
Had me not just weak in the knees but neautralized every muscle in my body.
First was anger.
I was angry because the moment it happened, I could see how this was a pattern and today I was just on the recieving end of Elike’s venom.
It made no difference what I tried to do to repair as it made no difference in time past when other people tried.
Elike had shut the door on me for good.
I didn’t understand it.
But then, I had a few more conversations with the relationships that had our contexts and so I started to rethink; maybe I had failed to see the bigger picture this whole time.
Maybe I was yet to realize how hard it was for Elike to be in this position and I was being selfish and only thinking about myself.
Maybe, just maybe I hadn’t empathized enough yet, reassured enough, begged enough… even though with every normal standing, the truth was that Elike was being extreme in his estimation of things.
Elike had started to spread word that I had been blackmailing him, trying to twist his arm just so he would let sleeping dogs lie and our relationship would go on like nothing had happened.
Elike had broken my heart by talking to me like I was the enemy.
Elike called me a betrayer, said I was gaslighting him.
I had known Elike for too many years, all of these terms sounded so foreign and out of place to be fit into our relationship.
They were hard sounding, hard meaning words to use to soil our relationship for something we both shared fault in.
I kept trying to extend an arm over the bridge just so Elike could hold on and we could reconnect.
Elike turned cold on my hand and said I was blackmailing him.
First it was anger, then I felt hurt, then I felt sorry for Elike because it was a typical case of “the stories we tell ourselves”.
I knew Elike so well, I knew what he was thinking.
Now, I was just one of those people in the past pages of his story that had hurt him again, taken from him, deceived him.
Elike meant the world to me.
I loved Elike more than I loved myself.
But Elike didn’t see that.
Like in past times, with other people, Elike could only see how I was a hinderance in his story, an obstruction that didn’t let him get what he wanted.
Elike was always very upset when he didn’t get what he wanted.
And whoever it was that stood in the way always always got burned.
I had seen it more than once before because I had been in Elike’s life long enough.
I had also wondered if it would ever be me on the receiving end.
Elike had finally burned me.
Maybe I should’ve seen it coming.
I should have.
But I loved Elike so much, I was willing to be blind, drag myself through the mud and beg to be loved back, to be appreciated.
I would’ve begged for my effort and sacrifice to be seen and appreciated.
I would’ve given Elike my skin if he asked for it…
I would’ve fed him my fingers for food if he was hungry and I had nothing else to give and even I wonder how that would’ve worked but that is how much I love Elike.
But Elike either did not know this or was in denial of the extent of my love for him.
Elike did not give me the benefit of the doubt.
Elike did not give us a fighting chance, a surviving chance.
Elike had labeled me the villian in his story so badly I was termed evil, a witch by people who had heard these stories.
Whereas I had, in all of my attempts the recount the events, continously tried to make excuses for the things I genuinely did not know.
My chest was starting to grow thick and heavy and big with bitterness but then I drank a cup of hot chocolate a few mornings ago.
Heart break is a reward for loving hard, even if it was the wrong person.
I don’t regret nothing.

Elike is one of my greatest loves and maybe it is a foolish thing to do, but somewhere somehow, I’m still sitting at the other side hoping that Elike crosses over, reaches out and tells me this was all such a terrible nightmare.
